avis.titre: One of the best toners I've used. An alternative to Thayers.
avis.texte: UPDATE - 2.5 years later - July 2025 - Thayers has left the building I don't think I've ever bought another Thayers since. Amazon keeps having this bottle at sub $5 and I keep buying. They're stocked up. Take it when I travel, 100%. Every night, I don't care where I am. Had one bottle leak in airplane luggage, that's fine, there was more than enough to finish the trip and get back home. ;) I. Kid. You. Not.... I'm on the boardwalk a few days ago, talking to someone while we're looking at outside exercise equipment being set up. She asks me "how old are you". I truly don't know and never tell. Really. So then she says, "well I say that because from what you are talking about you come across as really knowledgeable, but you look young. I mean young-young." Yes. She said "young-young" :) :) :) lolololol :D I love it! ORIGINAL REVIEW: (Reviewed in the United States on November 11, 2022) I originally bought this because my Thayers toner ran out. I was in a local drugstore and this was all that was available, for around $7. I purchased it, used it, and was very surprised. It is sustainably made with certified organic ingredients and is as natural as can be. When it ran out the idea came to me to check Amazon and I was pleasantly surprised again, haha, that the price was very competitive. Sooooo, I've been buying it here ever since. That was a year ago :) Give it a try! You may like it. The scent is not overpowering and a little goes a long way. Be sure to use a quality cotton pad.

I've been using this toner daily, and it leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean without making it feel overly dry. It helps remove any leftover impurities after cleansing, and my pores look smoother over time. The formula feels lightweight and refreshing. A great addition to my skincare routine!

avis.titre: The best facial toner you will ever use!
avis.texte: I absolutely love love love this witch hazel toner! It has been a staple in my skin care routine for the past year. It not only gives the skin a great post cleanse, it removes any remaining dirt, makeup, and oil that may be hiding deep underneath the skin. I use it morning and night, and if I'm home all day I use it in the middle of the day for a quick face fresh up. My face feels super fresh after using this toner, no tightness and no over-dry feeling. This is definitely one of my favorite heavy rotation buys. Great price as well.

avis.titre: Pretty good toner, but dear God THE SMELL.
avis.texte: The best descriptor I can give for the scent of this product is: A handful of napkins that have been liquidized, left at the bottom of a trash can that someone dumped a hint of wind burnt; not freezer burnt, trash juice and dirty dish water into. If you can get past the smell, it is a good toner. There is no stinging or burning sensation that some old school toners produce. It provides a nice clean feeling after use that I really like, it does not feel "stripping" at all. Feels like a genuinely good for your skin product. Only reason I can't give it 5 stars is because, I read the reviews and thought "the smell" comments must be exaggerating. I was sincerely wrong. This stuff is stanky.

I use this stuff daily, makes my face feel so fresh. I have very sensitive skin and it does not upset my skin Does clean my pores. Not like a nose strip, but does a decent job. I recommend it. Take your below of how well it cleans your face. This is after a long day at work, cleanses well.

I've been using this toner for a few months now and it has definitely become my first choice for toners. Yes, it does have a VERY strong scent of witch hazel but that's perhaps to be expected given the ingredients! In any case, it isn't an unpleasant smell and it does quickly fade. I've often found with some toners in the past that they irritate my skin and leave it red and prone to breakouts. That's why I had been using Simple toner for years as it was one of the few toners which my skin seemed to tolerate. However, I was looking to see if I could find a new toner which might prove better value for money as Simple toner can be a bit more expensive than a lot of others. That's how I came to try this toner as, although it might seem expensive at first glance, the bottle is very large so it does work out cheaper in the long run. I've found I actually prefer this toner above others as not only does my skin tolerate it, it seems to love it! It becomes really soft after applying the toner and doesn't feel dried out at all. My skin also looks clearer but who knows whether that's down to the toner or the cleanser or the moisturiser! In any case, I'd highly recommend giving this toner a go.

avis.titre: Dickinson’s Original Witch Hazel Pore Perfecting Toner .
avis.texte: This classic toner is a skin-care staple that truly delivers. The 100% natural distilled witch hazel feels refreshing on the skin and gently removes excess oil, dirt, and impurities without stripping or drying. It’s lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling clean, balanced, and prepped for serums or moisturizer. I’ve noticed my pores look more refined and less noticeable over time, and it helps keep breakouts at bay without irritation. It’s a simple step that really elevates my skincare routine perfect for morning and night. Fresh, effective, and easy to use, this toner is definitely for anyone looking to refine skin texture and control shine. 🌿✨

I have oily skin and this toner has become a staple in my routine. I primarily use it as a second-step cleanser after washing my face, and occasionally as a quick mask by applying it with cotton pads for a few minutes. It effectively removes any leftover impurities and excess oil without over-drying. The 16oz bottle is huge and very affordable—excellent value for money. I appreciate that it contains 100% natural witch hazel, but please note it also includes 14% Natural Grain Alcohol. You can definitely smell the alcohol when applying, but it doesn’t feel harsh on my skin. After use, my face feels fresh, clean, and never sticky or tight. It truly helps refine pores and control shine throughout the day. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a straightforward, effective, and budget-friendly toner!

I haven’t noticed a significant reduction in pimples, but I enjoy using it whenever my skin feels extra oily.
